commands.toggle: Switch Live CSS on or off

errors.bad_args: Live CSS got arguments it cannot read: {reason}
errors.braces: The braces of block {block} do not balance, so it would not stay within its breakpoints; close every opening brace.
errors.control: Block {block} has a control character other than a tab or a line break; remove it.
errors.no_project: No project is open, so Live CSS has nowhere to keep its draft; open a project first.
errors.too_long: The draft is too long for the views: at most {limit, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}} of CSS. Shorten it.
errors.too_many_blocks: The draft has more than {limit, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}; join some of them.
errors.unknown_breakpoint: The grid has no breakpoint "{id}"; choose one of its views' breakpoints.
errors.untrusted: Live CSS keeps its draft in the project's .rbrowser/out/live-css/, which needs workspace trust; trust the workspace first.

panel.confirmRemove: Remove block {n}? Its CSS goes; the other blocks stay.
panel.copyFailed: The clipboard refused the copy; select the CSS and copy it by hand.
panel.copyNothing: Block {n} has nothing to copy: it has no CSS, or none of its breakpoints is in the grid.
panel.empty: No CSS yet. Add a block and type: it applies in the views as you type.
panel.file: Kept in {file}, the whole draft as one stylesheet.
panel.noProject: No project is open: Live CSS keeps its draft in the project's .rbrowser/out/live-css/.
panel.nowhere: No view: none of its breakpoints is in the grid.
panel.scopeHint: None chosen: every view. Chosen: inside the media query of their widths, as Copy as media query gives it.
panel.untrusted: Live CSS keeps its draft in the project's .rbrowser/out/live-css/, which needs workspace trust: trust the workspace to edit it.

applyOnNavigate.description: A new document in a view - a navigation or a reload - gets the Live CSS draft at once. Off: it starts without it until you change the draft or switch it on again.
applyOnNavigate.help: A new document in a view, after a navigation or a reload, gets the Live CSS draft at once. Off: the page shows as it is until you change the draft or switch it on again, for instance to compare a page with and without the draft.
applyOnNavigate.label: Apply after a navigation

status.off: Off: the views show the page as it is; the draft is kept.
status.on: On: the draft applies in the views.

tools.clear: Removes every block of the Live CSS draft, so the views show the page as it is. Only in a trusted workspace.
tools.set: Sets the Live CSS draft, which applies in every view at once: css (one block) with breakpoints (breakpoint ids of the grid; none for every view - a block for chosen breakpoints applies inside the media query of their widths), or blocks (the whole draft, each with css and breakpoints); either switches the draft on unless enabled is false. enabled alone switches it on or off and keeps the blocks. Without arguments it answers the draft: each block's media query and the text Copy as media query gives, and the grid's breakpoints with their widths. Only in a trusted workspace and, over MCP, only while evaluate over MCP is allowed in the settings, since CSS can read page data out; kept in .rbrowser/out/live-css/ (draft.json, and draft.css as one stylesheet).
